title: Information Security Engineer
description: About Consilium Safety Group At Consilium Safety Group, we don’t just build technology, we create solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries such as marine, energy, rolling stock, and infrastructure. With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and operating in over 55 locations worldwide, we are a fast-growing global organization backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are on an ambitious journey of growth and transformation, investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent. This is an exciting time to join us. We are now looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the information security team at Consilium! About the Role As an Information Security Engineer at Consilium, you will combine hands-on security operations with strategic governance and compliance work. In practice, the role is split into two central pillars: Operational Excellence: Working hands-on to implement security controls, managing daily security activities, and acting as an internal subject matter expert. Strategic and Compliance-Oriented Leadership: Developing and driving our security strategy, ensuring we meet regulatory requirements, and continuously strengthening our security posture. You will help protect Consilium’s information assets, lead compliance efforts related to NIS2, and support alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, the EU CRA, and the AI Act. The role works closely with teams across IT, HR, R&D, Sales, and Marketing. Your Main Responsibilities In this role, you will manage day-to-day security operations activities as well as strengthening the ISMS, implement controls aligned with ISO 27001, NIS2, and NIST CSF, coordinate audits, develop policies, and provide risk reporting and advisory support across the business. Qualifications and Experience To succeed in this role, you bring strong technical security knowledge, incident-handling capability, and an interest in governance and compliance. Requirements Technical Environment: Solid understanding of Microsoft Defender suite, Azure/O365, Windows, and Linux. Networking & Security Tools: Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, segmentation, firewalls, SIEM, EDR/EPP, and patch management. Automation: Basic to intermediate scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, Bash, KQL, or Graph API). Incident & Frameworks: Experience with log analysis, incident lifecycles, and frameworks like ISO 27001 or NIST CSF. Communication: Ability to explain technical security concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Meriting Hands-on experience with Microsoft's advanced security stack (Sentinel, XDR, Entra, Intune, Purview/Priva). Cloud security controls (Azure), DevSecOps (GitHub Advanced Security), or direct audit-evidence collection experience. Previous experience working with audits and evidence collection linked to ISO 27001/NIS2/NIST CSF. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone with hands-on experience in IT security and information security compliance, along with a solid understanding of relevant regulations and security frameworks. You are structured, analytical, and able to communicate clearly with a wide range of stakeholders. Personal Attributes You are analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented, with high integrity and a structured way of working. You communicate clearly, work well independently, and build strong relationships across technical and non-technical teams. What We Offer At Consilium Safety Group, you will join an innovative international environment where quality and safety come first. This is a high-impact role with opportunities to shape global security initiatives, along with a competitive salary, benefits, and career development. Apply Now Does this sound like your next challenge? Submit your application as soon as possible, as we review applications on a rolling basis. Consilium Safety Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Ready to learn more about our journey? Hear from our CEO: Philip Isell Lind af Hageby, Consilium, en mästare på turnarounds - Värdeskaparna | En podd om riskkapital av OPX Partners | Podcast on Spotify

title: IT Security Engineer till internationell high-tech-miljö
description: Vill du arbeta brett inom cybersäkerhet och få möjlighet att påverka hur en säker IT-miljö faktiskt byggs upp? Här kliver du in i en teknikintensiv och internationell verksamhet där robusthet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet är avgörande – och där du får arbeta hands-on med allt från säkerhetsövervakning och identitetshantering till nätverk, cloud och endpoint security. Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill mer än att enbart förvalta befintliga säkerhetslösningar. Du kommer in i ett skede där mycket redan finns på plats, samtidigt som det finns stor möjlighet att vidareutveckla, strukturera och sätta din prägel på hur organisationen arbetar med IT-säkerhet framåt. Om tjänsten Som IT Security Engineer får du en bred teknisk roll i gränslandet mellan cybersäkerhet, nätverk och modern IT-infrastruktur. Verksamheten består av flera typer av tekniska miljöer – bland annat utvecklings-, produktions- och kontorsmiljöer – där säkerheten behöver fungera både i cloud och i fysisk infrastruktur. Det som särskiljer möjligheten är bredden. I stället för att arbeta med en avgränsad del av cybersäkerhet får du följa säkerheten hela vägen – från nätverk och endpoints till identitet, cloud, loggning och compliance. Du kommer dessutom in i en organisation med avancerad egen teknik, internationella samarbeten och höga krav på säkerhet och robusthet. Säkerhetsarbetet är under fortsatt utveckling, vilket innebär att du inte bara tar över någon annans lösning – du får vara med och forma hur den ska se ut framåt. För rätt person finns därför stora möjligheter att både bredda sin tekniska kompetens och få ett betydande ansvar inom ett område som står högt på agendan. Arbetsuppgifter En stor del av rollen handlar om att säkerställa att rätt säkerhetsnivå finns på plats när nya miljöer, system och tekniska lösningar etableras. Det kan exempelvis innebära att sätta upp säkerhetsövervakning och loggning för en ny miljö, konfigurera nätverkssegment och brandväggsregler, säkra klienter och servrar eller säkerställa rätt behörigheter i Azure. Du kommer samtidigt att vara med och utveckla organisationens övergripande säkerhetsförmåga. Här finns utrymme att identifiera förbättringsområden, föreslå lösningar och omsätta säkerhetskrav och ramverk till praktisk teknik. Rollen innebär även nära samarbete med tekniska kollegor internationellt, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta med säkerhetsfrågor över flera miljöer och geografier. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Bygga vidare på organisationens lösningar för säkerhetsövervakning, logghantering och SIEM Säkerställa att klienter och servrar har rätt skydd, exempelvis EDR, säkerhetssensorer och loggning Arbeta med segmentering av nätverk samt konfigurera switchar, brandväggar och säkerhetsregler Hantera identiteter, roller, behörigheter och åtkomst i Azure Arbeta med endpoint management och säkerhetspolicies, exempelvis genom Intune Delta vid etablering av nya tekniska miljöer och säkerställa att security by design genomsyrar lösningen Arbeta med sårbarhetshantering, härdning och andra tekniska säkerhetsåtgärder Dokumentera förändringar, säkerhetskonfigurationer och arbetssätt Bidra till att utveckla organisationens säkerhetsarbete utifrån etablerade ramverk och compliance-krav Vi söker dig somHar relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, cybersäkerhet eller motsvarande Har praktisk, hands-on erfarenhet av IT- eller cybersäkerhet i säkerhetskritiska miljöer, gärna från försvarsindustrin eller andra säkerhetskänsliga miljöer Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat i exempelvis en SOC, varit med och byggt upp eller utvecklat en IT-säkerhetsmiljö eller har erfarenhet av Azure, Intune och moderna cloudmiljöer. Vi tror att du är nyfiken på hela säkerhetsområdet och gillar att förstå hur tekniken faktiskt hänger ihop. Du behöver inte vilja nischa dig mot endast ett verktyg eller en del av cybersäkerheten – tvärtom passar rollen dig som tycker om kombinationen av nätverk, cloud, klienter, identitet och säkerhetsövervakning. Du är initiativtagande och bekväm med att identifiera vad som behöver förbättras, komma med förslag och själv driva arbetet framåt. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och förstår vikten av dokumentation, spårbarhet och tydliga processer i en säkerhetskritisk miljö. Framför allt motiveras du av möjligheten att vara med och bygga. Här finns stor frihet att påverka hur säkerhetsmiljön ska utvecklas, och bra idéer har kort väg från förslag till genomförande. Om anställningen Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer att var anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult ute hos vår kund. Övrig infoOmfattning: Heltid Start: Enligt överenskommelse Placering: Stockholm Lön: Marknadsmässig månadslön Kontaktperson: Anna Persson Om Friday På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Firewall & Network Security Engineer (all genders)
description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du fühlst dich sowohl in komplexen Netzwerkinfrastrukturen als auch in modernen Firewall- und Security-Umgebungen zuhause? Du möchtest nicht nur Regelwerke administrieren, sondern aktiv zur Sicherheit und Weiterentwicklung geschäftskritischer Netzwerke beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Als Firewall & Network Security Specialist (all genders) betreust du die Netzwerksicherheits- und Firewall-Landschaften unserer eigenen Infrastruktur sowie die unserer Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen und dem Systemhausumfeld. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Netzwerk, Security und Automatisierung, administrierst heterogene Firewall-Umgebungen, unterstützt bei der Absicherung komplexer Netzwerke und sorgst für einen sicheren, performanten und hochverfügbaren Betrieb geschäftskritischer Infrastrukturen.

Die Position kann sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit ausgeübt werden.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Strategie & Architektur: Du konzipierst, planst und implementierst zukunftssichere Firewall-Strategien und Regelwerke entlang strenger Sicherheitsanforderungen.
  • System-Integration & CLI: Du wählst passende Firewall-Hardware sowie -Software aus, konfigurierst diese (gerne auch direkt auf der CLI) und integrierst neue Security-Technologien.
  • Monitoring & Log-Analyse: Du überwachst Firewall-Logs und schließt Systemlandschaften an SIEM-Lösungen (Security Information and Event Management) an.
  • Incident Response & SOC: Du arbeitest eng mit dem SOC und weiteren IT-Teams zusammen, unterstützt bei der Analyse von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bringst deine Expertise in Sicherheitsreviews und Optimierungsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Automatisierung & Linux: Du nutzt deine Linux-Expertise und Skripting-Kenntnisse, um Netzwerk- und Firewall-Prozesse effizient zu automatisieren.
  • Dokumentation & Knowledge: Du pflegst Sicherheitsrichtlinien sowie Konfigurationen sauber und erstellst verständliche Leitfäden für den sicheren Umgang mit Netzwerksicherheitstechnologien.


Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung & Fundament: Abgeschlossenes IT-Studium oder eine IT-Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung in der IT-Sicherheit
  • Firewall- & Network-Security: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration und Wartung heterogener Firewall-Systeme führender Hersteller – die Arbeit auf der CLI ist dabei für dich selbstverständlich oder zumindest nicht neu
  • Linux & Automation: Solide Linux-Kenntnisse und idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von Netzwerk- oder Firewall-Prozessen (z. B. via Python, Ansible oder Bash)
  • Netzwerk-Know-how: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktopologien, Routing-Protokollen, VPNs und Segmentierungskonzepten
  • Incident Response & Audits: Praxiserfahrung in Sicherheitsbewertungen, der Analyse sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse sowie idealerweise in der Unterstützung von Incident-Response-Prozessen
  • Zertifizierungen (Bonus): Hersteller-Zertifizierungen im Firewall-Umfeld (z. B. Juniper, Fortinet, 6wind, Sophos) oder ITIL-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber kein MUSS
  • Soft Skills & Arbeitsweise: Starkes analytisches Denken, strukturiertes Troubleshooting und eine kommunikative, teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sprachkenntnisse:  Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

A mission-driven culture where performance meets impact. Our innovative campus brings together tech talent, professional athletes, students, and artists, creating an ecosystem where digital innovation drives both business growth and positive change. Job Description Your Mission As a Security Engineer , you’ll play a key role in shaping the security and resilience of Voyage Privé’s technology platform. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and Platform teams to embed security practices into every stage of product development, deliver measurable impact, and help us scale efficiently while maintaining a strong security posture. Develop automated security guardrails integrated into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning). Design secure architectures for applications , APIs, data flows, and integrations in partnership with engineering teams. Secure hybrid environments combining virtual machines, containerized workloads, and cloud-native services, ensuring consistent security standards across the entire platform. Drive proactive risk identification through continuous scanning, threat modeling sessions, risk assessments, and architecture reviews. Enable engineering teams to build secure-by-design practices by acting as a trusted advisor, developing internal tools, and leading security awareness sessions. Operational security & incident readiness : participate in on-call rotations, investigate security events, and improve incident response workflows. Lead security improvement projects : build automation, enhance tools, optimize processes, and foster a culture of security ownership. Qualifications What We’re Looking For We’re looking for builders who move fast, think big, and care deeply about creating impact that lasts Your profile: 5–7 years of experience in software engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, or equivalent technical security roles. Solid understanding of cloud security principles (AWS, GCP, Azure). Experience securing both virtualized systems (VMs) and containerized workloads. Strong knowledge of secure coding, OWASP Top 10, and application security fundamentals. Experience with SAST, SCA, container/IaC scanning, runtime security tools, IAM, and secrets management. Pragmatic, engineering-first mindset: able to balance security with developer experience, velocity, and real-world constraints. Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex security issues into actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive, autonomous, critical thinker with a continuous improvement mindset. Nice to have: previous experience or knowledge of compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS...) Task Debrief (60 min) – Discuss your task with members of the team On-Site Interview (60 min) – Meet the VP of Engineering to align on expectations, culture, and long-term impact. Location : Aix en Provence or remote, France Start Date : The sooner, the better Contract Type : Full-time / Permanent ❤️ You'll Love Joining Us Our HQ in the South of France offers an exceptional environment - natural, cultural, and digital - on a modern and eco-responsible campus. Governance, collaboration, and awareness Provide technical input to policies, standards, and procedures for IT, cloud, and endpoint security. Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, routing, VPN, firewalls, DNS) and how to apply segmentation and connectivity securely. Experience with SIEM/SOAR tools and log management (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar). Experience with endpoint security and management (EDR, MDM, configuration management) across Windows, macOS, and ideally also Linux. Ability to script/automate (PowerShell, Python, or similar) for policy deployment, hardening, and monitoring. Familiarity with information security management and risk handling - ISO/IEC 27001/27002, NIST CSF or SP 800‑53, and related controls. Experience working in or with regulated environments (aviation, defence, safety‑critical systems, or similar) is a strong plus. Understanding of secure software and infrastructure practices (least privilege, zero trust, secure configuration, change management). Who You Are You are proactive by nature, spotting challenges early and driving technically and organizationally sound solutions all the way to completion. You thrive in a small, hands-on IT team and collaborate seamlessly with security, engineering, and leadership across multiple European locations. You stay calm under pressure, manage incidents with confidence, and bring a continuous learning mindset to everything you do. Clear and direct communication in English comes naturally to you, both spoken and written, and any additional European language is a strong advantage.

description: Build the technology behind the teams transforming construction At XYZ Reality , we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes. As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we’re not only evolving the technology our customers use, we’re also investing in the tools and applications that enable our own teams to operate effectively as we grow. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of the internal applications, dashboards and AI-enabled tools that help power XYZ Reality behind the scenes. The Role This is a great opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building useful products, solving real business problems and owning what they create from idea through to production. As XYZ has grown, teams across the business have increasingly developed applications, dashboards, automations and AI-enabled tools to solve problems and improve how they work. We now need an engineer who can bring technical ownership to this space – taking promising ideas and prototypes and turning them into secure, scalable and maintainable applications. You’ll work directly with teams across XYZ to understand what they need, translate those requirements into technical solutions and build applications that people across the business will genuinely use. Because these tools can interact with employee, user and potentially customer data, you’ll also ensure they are built and deployed properly, with security, maintainability and appropriate engineering standards considered from the outset. This is a role with plenty of autonomy. You’ll own applications end-to-end, from architecture and data model through to UI, deployment, monitoring and ongoing iteration. And when internal priorities allow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your Full Stack skills to our wider product engineering team and the technology behind XYZ Reality’s engineering-grade AR platform. The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, ideally 2–3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work directly with the teams you’ll be building for while retaining flexibility. What You’ll Be Doing Design, build and maintain internal business applications end-to-end, from data model and architecture through to user interface. Take ownership of existing prototypes, dashboards and tools and evolve them into secure, reliable and maintainable applications. Ship quickly using modern serverless and Backend-as-a-Service platforms such as Vercel, Supabase and Firebase. Build applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and Node.js. Integrate AI capabilities, including LLM APIs, automation and agents, to improve and streamline business workflows. Work directly with stakeholders across XYZ to understand problems, gather requirements and translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Own the full application lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, maintenance and iteration. Ensure appropriate security and data protection standards are built into applications handling employee, user or customer information. Implement authentication, SSO and identity management where required. Champion good engineering practices across code quality, testing, security and CI/CD. Build integrations between internal systems, data sources and third-party platforms. Use feedback and usage data to continually improve the applications you build. Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities and identify where they can genuinely improve how XYZ operates. Contribute to our wider product engineering environment when capacity allows. What We’re Looking For Demonstrable in-depth professional software engineering experience, ideally within a Full Stack role. Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web development. Hands-on experience with React/Next.js and Node.js. Experience building and deploying applications using platforms such as Vercel, Supabase, Firebase or equivalent modern technologies. Experience owning applications beyond the initial build – including deployment, maintenance, monitoring and ongoing improvement. Comfortable integrating AI/LLM services into applications and using modern AI tooling as part of your development workflow. Experience implementing authentication and identity management, such as OAuth/OIDC, SAML or SSO. A good understanding of application security and how to appropriately handle sensitive business and user data. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with an appreciation for maintainable code, testing and good development practices. Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning their requirements into effective technical solutions. Able to work autonomously, prioritise effectively and take ownership of the applications you build. Experience within a startup, scale-up or modern technology environment would be particularly valuable, as would experience with Postgres/SQL, row-level security, data visualisation, reporting or workflow automation. We’re looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer with solid fundamentals who is comfortable learning new tools and making pragmatic technology choices based on the problem being solved. Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys building things that make a difference, an engineer who can take an idea or prototype, understand the problem behind it and turn it into technology the business can rely on. What You Could Be Working On From the outset, you could be working across projects including: Internal business applications and operational tools AI-enabled workflows and automation Business dashboards and reporting Employee and talent applications Data-driven internal tools Integrations between business platforms Secure applications handling employee, user and customer data Prototypes that need to evolve into scalable, production-ready applications As our internal technology needs continue to evolve, so will the problems you have the opportunity to solve. Why Join Us 🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days 🪙 Biannual salary reviews 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings 💰 Employee referral scheme 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme If you’re a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, shipping useful technology and using modern tools to solve real-world problems, we’d love to hear from you. title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple). KPIs & Success Measures Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings. title: Embedded Operations Officer - Global Security Operations Centre
description: We are seeking an Operations Officer to join our client’s Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC), based in Munich, Germany. This role is centred on the assessment and the response of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) to threats, incidents and crisis. Working complementarily with an Intelligence team, the successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring a coordinated response on threats, incidents and crisis. This is a duty-based position, requiring on-site presence at the client’s Munich office at the beginning, with potential flexible arrangement in the longer term. Responsibilities Execute initial response actions for threats and incidents, including containment measures, escalation, coordination with local teams, and liaison with local and emergency services where required. Monitor security systems and operational platforms, including travel security, mass notification, incident management tools, and respond to alerts in accordance with standard operating procedures. Maintain accurate and timely logs of activities, incidents, decisions, actions taken, and resolutions, ensuring compliance with documentation, reporting, and governance standards. Provide clear situational updates to internal stakeholders and the Operational Lead during incidents, special events, and periods of heightened threat. Conduct checks and coordinate with local management to verify security posture, identify gaps, and support the resolution of emerging issues. Assist in defining and implementing protective measures for executive travel, high-profile events, and special operations based on relevant intelligence information and operational requirements. Maintain continuous coordination with the GSOC Intelligence Team to ensure operational decisions, escalation, and protective measures are informed by timely and relevant intelligence. Support the Operational Lead in coordinating with internal business units and external partners, including law enforcement, emergency services, security providers, and other relevant response stakeholders during operational activities. Contribute to post-incident documentation, lessons-learned processes, after-action reviews, and the continuous improvement of standard operating procedures, playbooks, and response workflows. Participate actively in drills, table-top exercises, ongoing training, and readiness activities to maintain operational preparedness and improve GSOC effectiveness. Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, integrity, and adherence to data protection, operational security, and information-sharing requirements. Coordinate proactively with relevant internal and external stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in security management, criminal justice, emergency management, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained in security operations, law enforcement, military, or comparable operational environments. 2–5 years of experience in physical security operations, incident response, control room environments, or comparable 24/7 operational settings. Strong observational, analytical, and reporting skills, with the ability to assess information quickly and act decisively under pressure. Familiarity with security technologies and platforms, including mass notification systems, travel security platforms, incident management tools, and related operational systems. Understanding of hybrid threat environments, including physical, cyber, and reputational dimensions relevant to multinational organizations. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for stakeholder interaction during routine operations, major events, and crisis situations. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, duty-based environment and manage multiple priorities with a high degree of reliability. Experience handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion, integrity, and sound judgement. Fluency in English; an additional regional language is preferred. Fluency in German is a plus.

title: Professional Service Systems Engineer
description: Company Description Hirsch is a global leader in security technology, specializing in physical access control, video intelligence, and digital identification systems. Whether managing secure operations from anywhere or protecting identities from malicious attacks, we are committed to securing the future today. At Hirsch, we believe in the power of security, where physical access, video intelligence, and digital identification converge to protect the spaces and people that matter most. Our legacy spans over 43 years, earning us a reputation as a trusted partner in safeguarding everything from high-profile government buildings to local schools. We are more than just a security provider — we’re dedicated to creating a secure, connected world through digital innovation. In a small company, everyone matters, and everything we do matters. We believe having the best people in the most exciting, aligned, relevant and empowered roles with clear missions, goals and metrics, is the key to our success! Job Summary The Professional Service Systems Engineer works alongside technicians, technical support, other HPS engineers, and product managers to coordinate with the various Hirsch teams to deliver integration services and specialized support to Hirsch SLA customers. This particular role will act as a remote and onsite technical resource providing customer visibility, implementation services, scheduled and emergency maintenance services, advanced technical troubleshooting support, and problem resolution for our US and EMEA customers. Professional Service Systems Engineers must be able to manage hot issues by setting customer expectations, devising, and implementing action plans, being available as needed, and professionally communicating with all parties involved. Responsibilities and Duties · Provide hands-on involvement for technical installation and configuration of Hirsch products including troubleshooting, customer acceptance testing and completion documentation. · Conduct CSMS (Cybersecurity Management System) tasks, including deployment, implementation, monitoring, and improvement of security protocols. · Perform regular cybersecurity scanning, analyze vulnerabilities, and create detailed reports, and document findings and remediation steps. · Provide coaching for the customer-identified resource(s) who will be running day-to-day operation of the products. · Implement on-site solutions, while ensuring customer (partner and End User) satisfaction with Hirsch systems. · Serve as a technical authority on Hirsch product technologies via on-site, phone, and electronic media. · Provide technical support onsite, as well as via telephone, and electronic media. · Own and complete complex technical tasks for Hirsch clients including PoC engagements, within their pilot and production infrastructure. · Must be a US Citizen and be able to pass a federal background investigation as well as obtain and maintain a security clearance. · Act as a Trusted Advisor to customers. · Minimum 4 years of technical experience with Physical Access Control, Video, and Intrusion Detection Systems and/or related hardware/device · Hirsch product line knowledge · Ability to travel 50% across different Germany regions and work remote · Experience with storage arrays including SAN and NAS solutions · Experience with virtualization technology including VM Ware or Microsoft Virtual Server. · Experience with Microsoft Cluster technology · Experience with government technical publications and implementation desired (HSPD-12, FISMA, FIPS-12, DISA, NIST, FICAM) · CISSP, MCSE/MCITP, CCNA, Security+, Network+ preferred. Will consider related field (or equivalent) experience · Working knowledge of the following systems: Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019 and 2022 Windows 10, Windows 11. · Working knowledge of the following database system : SQL Server 2016, 2017, 2019 and 2022 · Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, IIS (Architecture, design, disaster recovery, and troubleshooting). · Working knowledge with Tenable Nessus, ACAS and SCAP Scanner, STIG checklists and WSUS update tools. · Superior problem solving and troubleshooting skills at the System Engineer level. · Exceptional customer service, overall communication, and technical writing skills · Ability to communicate and work with other internal departments · Ability to work independently with minimal management supervision and as part of the team · Demonstrated aptitude for providing exceptional customer service in politically charged environments · Ability to enhance the technical expertise of peers via the development of system training, mentoring of new hires, and team content development · Ability to apply technology to improve existing products and systems at customers and for internal use · Ability to actively participate in team support by proposing and implementing solutions · Assist in developing strategies to gain additional Premier support accounts by contacting and establishing relationships with Premier Support Managers and Technical Account Managers Other Desired Skills and Experience · Experience in sales of IT-Infrastructure devices and solutions a plus · German fluency is a plus · PKI and Smartcard experience are a plus · 2+ years of related experience with applied experience working with Local, State and Federal Government agencies on solutions, policies, processes, emerging technologies, and methodologies including but not limited to continuous evaluation and insider threat mitigation strategies is highly desirable

description: Shape the future of how the world's biggest Salesforce teams build, protect, and innovate. title: Technical Application Engineer
description: Do you enjoy taking ownership of complex technical environments? Do you like combining infrastructure, security and automation to keep mission-critical SaaS platforms? Then join the team behind Benefits-Plaza, Keylane's all-in-one Employee Benefits platform that connects employers, insurers and payroll providers across the Netherlands. As a Technical Application Engineer within our Technical Application Management (TAM) team, you are responsible for the availability, performance, security and continuous improvement of the Benefits-Plaza platform. You'll work closely with experienced engineers and act as a technical expert for one of our most important SaaS solutions. This is a hands-on role where infrastructure, middleware, security and automation come together. You'll regularly balance operational continuity, customer expectations and security requirements while making sound technical decisions under pressure. You'll be responsible for: Drive the resolution of complex platform incidents and problems, ensuring timely recovery while acting as the technical escalation point for internal teams and stakeholders. Monitor the Benefits-Plaza platform and proactively resolve operational issues, including resource bottlenecks, application outages and middleware failures (e.g. disk space, CPU usage and Tomcat availability). Contribute to daily operations: handling service requests and standard changes, following agreed ITIL processes. Managing service requests and standard changes in line with ITIL processes. Managing web service integrations, including networking, whitelisting, security configuration and end-to-end technical validation. Planning and executing maintenance activities, including patching and upgrading technologies such as RHEL, DB2, Tomcat and related components. Managing the lifecycle of client and server certificates, coordinating renewals and secure deployments. Lead the technical execution of external audits, penetration tests and disaster recovery exercises by preparing technical evidence, coordinating activities and driving remediation where needed. Driving automation and standardization by improving runbooks, scripts and operational tooling. Optimizing monitoring, capacity management and operational dashboards to improve platform reliability. Key about your team You'll be part of Keylane's Technical Application Management (TAM) organization, where we ensure our business-critical SaaS platforms are secure, stable and always available for our customers. Together, we: Deliver best-in-class SaaS services from a secure, ISO-certified private cloud, ensuring our customers can focus on pension administration while we manage the technical platform. The team consists of highly skilled IT professionals with strong expertise in infrastructure, databases, middleware and security, combined with deep knowledge of the Life & Pension domain. Work with standardized processes for migrations, implementations and operations, and continuously refine our way of working based on experience and feedback. Foster a collaborative culture where ownership, innovation and continuous learning are encouraged, and everyone has the opportunity to make an impact. You recognize yourself in the following profile: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or a related technical field. You have 5+ years of experience in technical application management, infrastructure operations or a similar role managing business-critical applications. You are experienced in managing application servers such as Apache Tomcat and have a solid understanding of their interaction with networking, security and the application stack layer. You have practical experience with security hardening, patching and vulnerability management, especially in regulated or audited environments. You are familiar with certificates (PKI), networking and firewalls, and know how to work with concepts like whitelisting, proxies and load balancers. You can script and automate (for example with PowerShell, Bash or Ansible) and are comfortable working with monitoring and deployment tools. You are analytical, structured and pragmatic, able to quickly understand complex situations and define clear next steps. You are a communicative team player: You work closely with colleagues and stakeholders and can translate technical issues into business impact. title: 2026-0083 Cyber Operations Mgmt System Demonstration (NS) - FRI 21 Aug RELAUNCH
description: Updates are highlighted in bold and underlined in the SOW. Bidding instructions are now included in the SOW, so a technical proposal is expected for this RFQ, not only CVs. Initial submitted bids can be resubmitted together with the now required technical proposal. BIDDING INSTRUCTIONS Price Quote: The Bidder shall submit a quote in accordance with the NTE provided in the Project Overview on page 1. Technical Quote: Bidders shall submit a proposal clearly providing the following information: a. The proposed approach to address the required scope of work and the defined deliverables. The proposed approach should address at the minimum: i. Sufficient details to allow assessment of the bidder’s understanding of the requirements; ii. Previous similar experience; and iii. Relevant experience of the proposed personnel. b. CV(s) and attestation(s) of the assigned personnel for the project. Deadline Date: Friday 21 August 2026 (was Wednesday 19 August 2026) Requirement: Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) Demonstration Location: Offsite Note: Please refer to your Subcontract Agreement, article 6.4.1.a, which states “Off-Site Discount: 5% (this discount is applicable to all requirements, and applies when the assigned personnel are permitted to work Off-Site, such as at- home)". Please be sure to price this discount in your overall price proposal when submitting bids against off-site RFQs Period of Performance: EDC + 4 months. Estimated start date: 1 September 2026 (tentative) Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET SECTION 1 – INTRODUCTION 1.1 Background The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) is dedicated to acquiring, deploying, and defending communication systems for NATO's political decision-makers and Commands. It operates on the frontlines against cyber-attacks, collaborating closely with governments and industry to prevent future debilitating attacks. The NCI Agency plays a crucial role in maintaining NATO's technological edge and ensuring the collective defence and crisis management capabilities of the Alliance. In pursuit of this mission, NCIA requires specialized advisory services to enhance its interim workforce capacity. The Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) demonstration is a high priority task which aims at: Building a mock-up environment on the NATO Software Factory to obtain a functionally equivalent environment to the operational version of Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) today. Capturing the requirements and demonstrating to industry the functionalities of the current capabilities by demonstrating on the mock-up environment. COMS operates on the NCSC NROP and NCSC NSOP CIS and is accessible from NATO-wide stakeholders from their respective low-side and high-side environments. COMS supports Cyber Incident Response and Defensive Cyber Operations and is therefore a critical component of the NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) today and the NATO Integrated Cyber Defence Centre (NICC) tomorrow. 1.2 Scope of Work The purpose of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to acquire contractor support to build a mock-up environment of the current COMS NR and COMS NS. Based on the mock-up of the environment, the contractor shall identify and capture the requirements of what COMS is able to deliver today in a video demo to be presented at a planned industry engagement day. SECTION 2 – PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS 2.1 Deliverable D1: Mock-up of COMS NR/NS Environment on the NATO Software Factory The contractor shall build a mock-up environment that simulates what is doable today on COMS NR and COMS NS, including the relation between Atlassian JIRA, Atlassian Confluence, and all plugins currently installed on the production environment. It will notably replicate all Jira processes supporting the execution of the DEFEND branch missions, as well as all other supporting Jira processes (including but not limited to 'STAGIL assets' projects). It will also replicate the mechanism allowing low-side workflows tracking from the high-side with the associated hand-over/take-over mechanism, the dynamic wiki page publications based on Jira issues changes, and the use of dynamic page templates (scaffolding/reporting-based). Acceptance Criteria D1 All existing processes at the first day of Contract Award on COMS (Jira) NR and COMS (Jira) NS have a functional equivalent process on the mock-up environment. All data-types used for any of these processes have corresponding mock-up data implemented that will allow at least 10 different instances of each process to be run without using the same data twice. Any Confluence space and pages used in support of these processes must also exist on the mock-up environment, including dynamic elements, labelling, and all plugins as on production. The simulation of the Data diode and the replication mechanism must be implemented. Due Date: 60 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 40% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed Delivery Acceptance Sheet (DAS). 2.2 Deliverable D2: Identification and Documentation of the COMS Requirements Based on the mock-up environment established in D1, the contractor shall identify and capture the functional and non-functional requirements of what COMS is able to deliver today into a NATO AQAP conforming format that is readable and unambiguously understandable by a third-party company having no prior knowledge of NCSC, NCIA, or NATO. The requirements shall be organized in logical groups to facilitate the production of a video in D3. The requirements shall be written such that a third party could recreate, using one or multiple technical capabilities, a solution that would satisfy the identified requirements. The requirements will be captured within the COMS Confluence environment until final review is agreed. The final deliverable will be in Word document format. Acceptance Criteria D2 The requirements shall meet the following principles: each requirement must be unique, testable, verifiable, unambiguous, traceable and necessary in accordance to the relevant NATO AQAP. Due Date: 45 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. 2.3 Deliverable D3: Creation of a Video Demonstrating the Identified Requirements in D2 The contractor shall produce a recorded video introducing what COMS is today, and going through the different requirements captured in D2. The requirements document shall identify the timestamp in the video at which each requirement is being presented. The video in D3 and the requirements in D2 will be made available to industry as part of pre-solicitation industry engagements. The video shall be securely hosted by the contractor. A copy shall be delivered to NCIA. The video shall remain available on the contractor-hosted platform, and as per D4, for a duration of contract end plus 2 months. Acceptance Criteria D3 The video shall be endorsed by NCIA. Minimum resolution: 1920x1080p using H.264/AVC encoding. Supporting audio shall be a minimum of 44 kHz. The voice explaining the content of the video must be from a person having STANAG 6001 Speaking skills of level 4 minimum or from an English native speaker. The content of the material shall meet or exceed ISO 40180, and cover all requirements identified and endorsed in D2. Due Date: 70 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. 2.4 Deliverable D4: Demonstration of the COMS Mock-up Environment The contractor shall present a live demo of the COMS mock-up environment as part of an industry engagement day organized by NCIA. The demo will take place online. The live demo shall cover the points of the video in D3, with an authorized level of interaction (questions from industry). The Q&A session may be organized at the end of or during the demo, as best determined by the contractor. NCIA is responsible for inviting industry and setting the date of the demo. The contractor shall ensure availability and full working condition of the environment at the time of the demo. Depending on the risk of non-availability, an alternate date may be set by common agreement between NCIA and the contractor. NCIA will be present during the demo to answer questions. Acceptance Criteria D4 The live-demo occurred and all invited industry members who expressed their confirmation to attend have been able to attend. No disruption of video, audio of more than 5 seconds or dropping connection for participants caused by the contractor have happened. Due Date: 100 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. SECTION 3 – CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS 3.1 Contractor Experience [See Requirements] 3.2 Personnel Requirements The Contractor shall determine and provide the appropriate number and composition of personnel — possessing the necessary qualifications, skills, and experience — to successfully fulfil all requirements of this effort, taking into consideration the very tight delivery timeline. NCIA expects 3 persons to work on this SOW to meet the deadlines. The Contractor shall ensure that the proposed team is capable of delivering high-quality, timely, and fully compliant deliverables as specified in this SOW. Only the company's project manager must hold a NATO SECRET security clearance, necessary to access the production environment. Other contractor staff must be authorized at NATO RESTRICTED level. The work shall be executed fully at the contractor's facilities. SECTION 4 – PROJECT MILESTONES AND DELIVERABLES Deliverable D1: Mock-up of COMS NR/NS environment on the NATO Software Factory. Due: 60 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 40% of contract value. Deliverable D2: Identification and documentation of the COMS requirements. Due: 45 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Deliverable D3: Creation of a video demonstrating the identified requirements in D2. Due: 70 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Deliverable D4: Demonstration to selected industry members of the COMS mock-up environment. Due: 100 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Payment is dependent upon successful acceptance of each deliverable and the signed Delivery Acceptance Sheet (DAS). Invoices shall be accompanied by the DAS, signed by the contractor and the NCIA POC. SECTION 5 – COORDINATION AND REPORTING Reporting mechanisms will be defined during the kick-off meeting. SECTION 6 – SCHEDULE The Task Order will be effective immediately after contract signature. The estimated starting date is 15 July 2026 (tentative), with a period of performance of EDC + 4 months. SECTION 7 – TRAVEL There is no travel expected. Exceptionally, if any travel is required, costs are considered to be included in the overall contract price and will not be reimbursed separately. SECTION 8 – PURCHASER-FURNISHED INFORMATION AND RESOURCES NCIA to fund the access to the NATO Software Factory. NCIA to deliver the laptops necessary to access the NATO Software Factory (maximum 3 laptops). NCIA to provide technical support (1 hour per working day) to assist the contractor in delivering on scope, time, schedule, and expected quality. 3. CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS Required Experience and Skills Excellent knowledge (5+ years) of Atlassian JIRA Datacenter administration. Excellent knowledge (5+ years) of Atlassian Confluence Datacenter administration. Prior experience working on the NCIA COMS Environment. Excellent knowledge in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation and customization tasks. Excellent knowledge in deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure environments. Excellent knowledge of Java, Groovy, and ScriptRunner. Strong experience in dynamic content management and integration between Atlassian JIRA and Confluence. Strong experience in managing metadata in Atlassian Confluence, Office and PDF documents, and Microsoft SharePoint. Strong understanding of the inner workings of Atlassian JIRA and Confluence instances, including at database level. Experience with the management of Linux servers (preferably RedHat). NATO SECRET security clearance required for the project manager. NATO RESTRICTED authorization required for all other contractor personnel.

title: Insider Risk Program Coordinator

title: Endpoint & Microsoft 365 Security Engineer (Ghent)
description: D-ploy is an IT and Engineering Solutions company delivering services to organisations across the EMEA region and the United States. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer specialising in endpoint, Microsoft 365 and email security. This is a hands-on role focused on protecting user devices, collaboration platforms and communication technologies by ensuring that security controls are correctly configured, effectively monitored and continuously improved. The role combines technical engineering with operational security ownership. You will review security configurations, identify weaknesses and risky exceptions, coordinate remediation activities and provide clear visibility into the organisation’s endpoint, Microsoft 365 and email security posture. This is a remote-first position, with occasional travel to company offices when required. You will collaborate with Workplace Technology, IT Operations, Security Operations, business stakeholders, external vendors and specialist service providers. Your responsibilities will include: Protecting corporate laptops, desktops, supported mobile devices and other managed endpoints throughout their lifecycle, ensuring they remain securely configured, monitored and compliant. Maintaining and improving endpoint security baselines, including endpoint protection, EDR/XDR health, vulnerability scanning, device telemetry, patching and update compliance. Investigating and coordinating the remediation of devices that are degraded, non-compliant or no longer reporting correctly. Managing or supporting organisational controls for permitted and prohibited applications. Operating and enhancing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls, particularly Conditional Access, device compliance, privileged access and local administrator protection. Supporting Microsoft Purview security and compliance capabilities, including information protection, Data Loss Prevention, audit, eDiscovery and retention-related controls. Working with privacy and compliance stakeholders to ensure that relevant Purview controls are appropriately implemented and maintained. Managing or providing strong operational support for Microsoft 365 and Mimecast email security controls. Reviewing and improving anti-spoofing, spam, phishing, attachment handling, impersonation and Business Email Compromise protections. Maintaining email authentication and reporting controls, including DMARC, DKIM, SPF and user phishing-reporting processes. Identifying and resolving email security assessment findings, configuration gaps and inappropriate exceptions in collaboration with internal teams and external specialists. Establishing practical operating procedures, dashboards, control evidence, KPIs and continuous improvement actions for endpoint, Microsoft 365 and email security. Using security incidents, phishing trends, audit observations, assessment results and user experience issues to develop sustainable improvements to security controls. Documenting remediation activities, assigning clear ownership and ensuring that actions are supported by appropriate evidence. At least five years of relevant security engineering or operational security experience within enterprise environments. Practical experience configuring, governing, reviewing or assessing endpoint and Microsoft 365 security controls. Strong hands-on knowledge of endpoint security, endpoint hardening, EDR/XDR, endpoint telemetry and patch or update compliance. Experience working with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Intune, including device compliance and the monitoring of endpoint security health. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID security, particularly Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication, device posture, privileged access, audit logging and secure access governance. Good understanding of Microsoft 365 email security and secure email gateway controls. Experience with anti-spoofing, phishing and spam protection, attachment policies, impersonation and Business Email Compromise controls. Knowledge of DMARC, DKIM, SPF, phishing-reporting processes, exception handling and safe links or safe attachments concepts. Familiarity with Microsoft Purview capabilities, including information protection, Data Loss Prevention, audit, eDiscovery and retention concepts. Experience using administrative and investigation tools such as Microsoft Defender portal, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra admin centre and Exchange admin centre. Familiarity with Mimecast administration or comparable secure email gateway technology. Direct Mimecast experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, KQL or similar security monitoring and investigation tools. Familiarity with vulnerability scanning or vulnerability management platforms such as Qualys. Experience working with ServiceNow or similar platforms for incident management, exception handling and remediation tracking. Ability to produce and maintain meaningful security reports and dashboards using tools such as Excel or Power BI. Strong ability to review technical configurations, identify weak controls, bypasses or risky exceptions and convert findings into structured remediation plans. Experience with operational governance, evidence collection, security exception management, incident or alert handover and remediation follow-up. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, vendors and business stakeholders. Ability to balance security requirements with operational constraints and user experience considerations. Relevant security or Microsoft certifications are desirable but not mandatory. Valid criminal record extract, not older than three months, required.

Translate identified risks into clear remediation actions, accountable owners and realistic target dates. At least 5 years of relevant experience within enterprise IT environments. Hands-on experience in infrastructure security, cloud security engineering or a closely related security role. Practical experience securing Microsoft Azure and AWS environments. Familiarity with hybrid infrastructure, Windows and Linux servers, networking and security appliances. Strong knowledge of Vulnerability Management, including: Asset and scanning coverage Authenticated vulnerability assessments Finding validation Risk-based prioritisation Asset and remediation owner identification Remediation tracking Exception management Verification and reporting Demonstrable experience identifying and remediating cloud vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses in collaboration with infrastructure, cloud and operational teams. Strong understanding of Secure Configuration Management, hardening principles and security baselines. Experience developing or applying secure configurations for: Windows and Linux servers Azure and AWS services Network and security infrastructure Privileged remote-access tools Internet-facing systems Exposure to security and IT service management tools such as Qualys, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, ServiceNow or comparable platforms. Good understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIS2, CyFun, CIS Benchmarks and secure-by-design principles. Ability to interpret technical security findings and clearly communicate the related business risk, required actions, ownership and remediation timelines. Confidence working with infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, network specialists, architects, security teams, suppliers and external partners. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and drive issues through to resolution. Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining effective collaboration across technical and business teams.
